Earn big as a warehouse worker at DSV in Venlo! With a starting salary of € 15,55 per hour plus extra shift allowances after 7:00 PM, you're set up for success. You will work full-time in a friendly team where the day flies by. See yourself shining in this role? Read on and apply directly!

What we offer
- A salary of € 15,55 per hour!
- After 7:00 PM you earn €19,53 per hour!
- Working in 2 shifts!
- Travel allowance!
- A job with career opportunities!
- An in-house Tempo-Team office!

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you, as a warehouse employee, meet the following requirements:

- You speak Dutch and/or English.
- You have your own transport.
- You are physically able to lift boxes up to 20 kilos if necessary.
- You are available within a week.
- Full-time available
- Available in 2 shifts.
- You can work in Venlo.
- You have your own accomodation.

What will you do
Are you going to work as a warehouse worker at DSV? Then you get started with an English voice picking system! You will be told via this system which products you need to collect. You will also be told which location to take this to! You take the products and stack them on a pallet. Then you seal it closed. Everything is ready to ship! As an order picker you are very flexible. You don't mind helping out in another department every now and then! One team, one task! Do you also want to continue growing after a while? That's possible! Who knows, you might end up being the new team leader! :)

- Workdays: Monday to Friday.
- Worktimes: in two shifts from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM and from 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM.

Where will you work
As a warehouse worker at DSV, you will work in a large warehouse. This location can be found at Popeweg 50 in Venlo. Do you have your own car, scooter or bicycle? This makes the location easy to reach! You also occasionally work at different locations. But luckily you are flexible! You don't work alone in this large warehouse, but with a super fun team!

Are you looking for a new challenge? Would you like to work for a company long-term? Join Mola as an all-round bakery worker and help pack the most delicious croissants, frikandel rolls, and apple turnovers! Earn €16,12 gross per hour for day shifts and €22,41 gross per hour for night shifts.
Apply now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions so we can help you quickly. Don't have a WhatsApp? Then we'll contact you by phone or email! #baanrader

What we offer
- Hourly wage of €16,12 per hour excl shit allowance
- Work in a modern, innovative company
- Travel allowance and holiday pay
-  6 days on, 4 days off!
- Including bonuses, a salary of €22,41 per hour

Who you are
As an all-round bakery worker, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You speak Dutch, English, or German
- You are willing to work rotating shifts on varying days
- You are available for night shifts when needed
- You are physically able to stand for the entire shift and perform repetitive tasks

- You have your own transportation to work in Beugen
- You are available for a longer period

What will you do
As an allround bakery worker, you play a crucial role in the production process of delicious puff pastry products, such as cheese rolls and croissants. In our large production hall, these products are made from start to finish, frozen, and carefully packaged.

Your task? Ensuring that products are neatly packed into different boxes. This is repetitive work, but you won't be doing it alone! Together with a team of great colleagues and with the help of modern machines, you make sure everything runs smoothly.

Mola operates 24/7, which is why you will work in a 5-shift system. Before stepping onto the production floor, it's important to prepare properly. This means putting on a hairnet, washing your hands, and wearing clean work shoes.

Where will you work
Mola B.V., located at Vuu
